fusions.name: Flick and Snap
fusions.desc: A darting snap that deals 5 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles, with a 25% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: From Utter Stillness
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignores resistances, with 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Licked and Regrown
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you. Its healing rises 6% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 30%).

fusions.name: Sunned on the Rocks
fusions.desc: By day, you deal 10% more damage.
